items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: He gave me some complementary tickets up there, and I heard him sing. Oh boy, he can sing. And I went to his dressing room afterward.

ctx.x: kind of stuff! [LAUGHS] And we were workin' on this thing, you know, and laugh-in.

He gave me some complementary tickets up there, and I heard him sing. Oh boy, he can sing. And I went to his dressing room afterward. He comes out with a bathrobe on, he's wringing wet, and he says, "You see, Jimmy? That's where Jazz comes from!" Heh-heh... "Yes, Placido, I understand." He wouldn't know me now, but he'd remember.

I'll bet he remembered when they first tried to talk about that picture, you know, Carmen, that they advertise in the paper. I'll bet he remembered that night, and started laughing. He probably told everybody about it. He said, "I met this crazy piano player," you know, boom-boom and away we go...
